entry.author: New Zealand Story
entry.summary:
This video introduces the Trade Partnership Story, highlighting why New Zealand is a trusted and values‑driven trading partner with more than two centuries of export experience.

It explores how New Zealand blends natural strengths with a progressive, partnership‑focused approach to business, and features insights from business leaders in New Zealand and around the world.

Hear why global partners choose to work with New Zealand, and how our way of doing business continues to create long‑term value across international markets.
